map.SWOLF = 单趟时间(秒) + 划水次数，综合评估游泳技术经济性；同时给出每: SWOLF = lap time (seconds) + stroke count gives an overall measure of swimming economy; the tool also returns distance per stroke (DPS) and stroke rate (SR), where lower is more efficient.
map.；每划距离 DPS = 池长 / 划次；划频 SR = 划次 / 时间 × 60: ; distance per stroke DPS = pool length / stroke count; stroke rate SR = strokes / time × 60. Reference bands for 25 m freestyle: under 35 elite / 35–42 excellent / 43–50 good / 51–60 average / 61–70 beginner / over 70 novice.
map.选择泳姿与泳池长度。: Choose the stroke and the pool length.
map.输入单趟划水次数与用时。: Enter the stroke count and elapsed time for one lap.
map.结果区显示 SWOLF、DPS、SR 与效率等级。: The result area shows SWOLF, DPS, SR, and an efficiency grade.
map.降低 SWOLF：减少划水次数（提升滑行性）同时保持速度。: Lower SWOLF: cut the stroke count (improve glide) while holding speed.
map.提高 DPS：强化划水力与身体流线。: Raise DPS: strengthen stroke power and streamline the body.
map.SWOLF 跨泳姿不可直接比较；同泳姿纵向对比才有意义。: SWOLF cannot be compared across different strokes; only longitudinal comparison within the same stroke is meaningful.
map.SWOLF 越低越好吗？: Is a Lower SWOLF Always Better?
map.在同泳姿同池长下，越低代表技术经济性越高。: For the same stroke and pool length, lower means better technical economy.
map.划频越高越好吗？: Is a Higher Stroke Rate Always Better?
map.不是。过高划频往往伴随打滑，应追求 DPS 与 SR 的平衡。: No. A very high stroke rate usually comes with slipping; aim for a balance between DPS and SR.
